content.short: t3rn is a reversible cross-chain settlement layer: intents fill on proof or refund on failure.
content.description: t3rn provides reversible settlement for cross-chain operations: a user submits an intent once, and it either fills on proof or refunds on failure, with a receipt either way. Escrowing until proof removes the case where funds get stuck halfway through a cross-chain transfer. It supports Unichain among its networks.
content.meta: t3rn is a reversible cross-chain settlement layer where intents fill on proof or refund, including Unichain.
